stations.title: Till
stations.text: Stops with undefined after every payment.

stations.title: Theo
stations.say: Paid, and the stock went down.

captions: Errors make sense now. Next, Ines pours a winter edition of only twenty.
The till stops with an error about undefined every time a customer pays.
You give candles their own methods, write a class for them, and build one on it.
The snow candle sells when the payment comes in, and its label says limited.
Each candle carries what it can do, and the till sells from it without a crash.
